log.title: Born in Briar Glen
log.body: Kit welcomes you home. Your story starts here.

log.title: The music box
log.body: Reach for the key. Your fingers close around the key. Years later, the tiny tooth marks will still be there.

log.title: An indoor rainbow
log.body: Paint the paper. Your first painting goes up on the fridge. Kit calls the blue blob a whale.

log.title: The button tin
log.body: Sort them by color. You invent a category for buttons that look almost, but not quite, like the moon.

log.title: A very good puddle
log.body: Jump in with both feet. You come home with wet socks and a wildly inaccurate story about a tidal wave.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: Someone puts soft socks on you. You make a dedicated effort to remove them.

log.title: The other half
log.body: Share your apple slices. By lunch you have a trade agreement. By Friday you have a best friend.

log.title: One hand on the seat
log.body: Say the word. The hedge catches you at the end. Before that, for twelve whole seconds, you fly.

log.title: A book out of place
log.body: Follow the penciled trail. The hollow tree holds a tin of jokes. You add a very bad one of your own.

log.title: The missing tooth
log.body: Try a careful repair. You bend the tooth back with a teaspoon. Three crooked notes fill the room again.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: Someone draws a hopscotch grid that stretches halfway down your street.

log.title: One blue ticket
log.body: Ride the little coaster. You keep your eyes open on the big drop, which is almost as tall as the lemonade stand.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: The pavement stays warm long after the sun goes down.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: You grow just tall enough to see over the bakery counter.

log.title: A table of your own
log.body: Start a zine. Issue one is four folded pages. Jamie asks you to sign the first copy.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: You spend an entire rainy afternoon rearranging your room just right.

log.title: The night before
log.body: Revise with Jamie. You invent terrible rhymes for all the hard bits. A few actually stick.

log.title: The first real paycheck
log.body: Take the café shift. Your apron smells like cinnamon. You walk home with your first pay envelope.

log.title: Inside the sleeve
log.body: Stitch in a little poem. The rhyme is crooked. So is the seam. You wear both proudly.

log.title: Three envelopes
log.body: Accept the scholarship. Your tuition is covered. You pack light and leave room for books.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: You find a café table that catches the morning light just right.

log.title: Room with a leak
log.body: Learn to patch the roof. The first patch leaks. The second holds all winter.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: A postcard from out of town spends the year on your fridge.

log.title: Time with Jamie
log.body: You and Jamie turn a short catch-up into a long afternoon.
